Reads Google traffic colours along the route (https, anonymous browser identity) and routes around red jams. Car profile only.
Offer up to five routes side by side: traffic-aware variants, shortest, and the plain route.
A light band runs along the gold glow of the selected route and sparkles twinkle on it. Off: the glow stays steady.
Around jams and long slow traffic

Prices every car route at the speed you drive on each road type and limit, not at the limit itself. Uses the full route search, which is slower than the fast precomputed one. Long press a row to go back to the speed you set first.
Set in 白い熊 UI → My driving speeds while “Route with my speeds” is on. Tap to open.
Speed on roads of unknown type
Arrival time follows my recent speed
Off: the arrival time is the route’s own, with your speeds and the current traffic. On: it moves towards your average moving speed over the span below, which can’t see a jam ahead.
Every road counts as at least the slowest speed. The fastest is always your fastest row. The Travel speed screen of the car profile is greyed out while this is on.
Time lost at a traffic light
Prompts rendered ahead by 白い熊 音声

With 白い熊 音声 as the system voice (1.0+016 or newer) and Japanese guidance, the coming turn prompts are rendered sentence by sentence before they are due and played by 地図 the moment they are. A prompt still rendering when a newer one comes is dropped, and nothing is said after the arrival. Off, or without 音声: the plain TTS engine.
All off by default. While a switch is on, its lines go to %1$s — read them there with adb, or export them below.
Every fix from the phone and the car: position, accuracy, speed, bearing, its true delay and how far the clock is off. About one line a second while moving.
While navigating, the off-route check of every fix: distance from the route, the allowed deviation, wrong direction, and whether it recalculates.
Every recalculation and what started it, the search engine and its time, the route chooser’s candidates, the arrival-time predictions and the arrivals.
Each traffic check while navigating: the jams found, the roads banned, the time a reroute would save and the reroutes taken.
Every prompt: its text, pre-rendering by 白い熊 音声, render and play times, prompts dropped as stale, and audio focus.
The map’s link to the location, its zoom, tilt and compass mode, and what changed them.
The car screen’s map and navigation screens, and every few seconds the phone screen’s bottom views while the car has the map.
How long the drawer button’s long press and the 白い熊 地図 UI page take.
One row per road section driven, navigating or not — road type, limit, traffic colour, length, time and speed — for fitting your own speeds.
